messages:
natalie: FYI escalation from ACME Corp — customer reports spikes of 502s + timeouts against hosted inference in sfo1 starting ~04:12 UTC. They also see auth failures and sudden billing token usage. Opening thread for triage.

oncall-bot: Incident created (INC-2026-849). Severity: high. Assigned: @sre_sam.

sre_sam: grabbing logs now. Do we have SFO1 edge metrics up? Which AZ(s) are affected?

natalie: ACME provided request ids: req=acme-9a3f, acme-9a77, acme-9b01. Appears cross-AZ: customers in sfo1-a and sfo1-b see errors.

jing: looking at egress telemetry — we have a clear spike in retransmits and TCP RSTs from sfo1-edge-02 -> carrier-AS64512 starting 04:10 UTC. Packet loss ~6-8% on that path.

raj: can you paste the traceroute / mtr snippet? cc: @customer_ops_amy for customer comms.

jing: here are the MTR stats from sfo1-edge-02 to 13.34.56.78 (customer-facing gateway):
```
Start: 2026-03-17 04:16:12 UTC
HOST: sfo1-edge-02
1. 10.0.4.1   0.3%   1.2ms
2. 192.0.2.5  0.5%   4.8ms
3. 203.0.113.12  6.5%  45.2ms  <-- carrier-AS64512
4. 13.34.56.78   6.7%  60.1ms
```

jing: note the jump at hop 3 (carrier). Also see increased socket errors in gateway logs: 
```
[04:12:14] upstream reset by peer, conn_id=0x7f2e
[04:13:09] write timeout, req=acme-9a3f, route=sfo1-edge-02
```

sre_sam: thanks. That points to provider-side instability. Confirmed elevated 502 rate from edge -> upstream during window. Any routing/BGP churn reported?

jing: BGP state flaps coincide at 04:11 from provider peering (AS64512) — minor AS path changes and increased AS path prepends.

raj: I'm starting the runbook for carrier path issues: reroute customers away from sfo1-edge-02 via dynamic-policy to sfo1-edge-01 & sfo1-edge-03. Applying policy now.

sre_sam: also enable fallback to compatible model variant in the routing policy for affected tenant to reduce retries. Patching routing config: 
```
PATCH /api/v1/routing/policy/sfo1
{ "match": {"tenant": "acme"}, "fallback_edges": ["sfo1-edge-01","sfo1-edge-03"] }
```

natalie: customer_ops_amy — please update ACME with planned mitigation (reroute + we are engaging transit provider). Keep tone: we're investigating and implementing mitigation.

customer_ops_amy: pinged ACME: "We observed transient packet loss affecting sfo1 egress to some carriers. We're rerouting your traffic and coordinating with the transit provider; will follow up in 15m with status."

oncall-bot: Automation: reroute policy applied to tenant=acme, propagated to edges (sfo1-edge-01, sfo1-edge-03).

jing: after reroute at 04:22, retransmits dropped to baseline and 502 rate for ACME fell from 12% -> 1.3% in 5m. Kernel NIC drops show backlog cleared on sfo1-edge-02.

sre_sam: good. Still see a small auth error tail for some tokens — investigating token store timeouts during retries. Could be SDK clients hitting expired tokens after repeated 502s.

natalie: ACME also reported a billing spike — likely caused by client-side retry logic firing during the 502 storm. We should offer credit and advise on idempotency / retry window adjustments.

raj: opened ticket with transit provider AS64512 (TP-98721). Provider acknowledges microburst on peering and will throttle shaping on transit for affected PoP.

customer_ops_amy: emailed ACME with mitigation details + offer to review retry strategy. They asked for repro steps — provided curl example and request ids.

customer_ops_amy: curl we gave them to reproduce (from their side):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

jing: follow-up: we should add a temporary grafana alert for egress packet loss >3% on any edge to catch similar early. Filing a dashboard ticket.

sre_sam: summary/status: mitigation applied (reroute + provider engaged). Error rates back to normal for ACME. Provider still investigating root cause. Actions: 1) provider follow-up & postmortem, 2) customer credits review, 3) grafana alert for egress loss, 4) short-runbook update (include token-retry guidance).

natalie: thanks team. I'll update the incident ticket and customer. Reopen if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

customer_ops_amy: ACME replied: "Thanks for quick action, error rates are good now. We'll accept the credit and would like a postmortem."

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-849 status -> mitigated. Log snapshot saved to s3://incidents/2776105432/snapshot.log

sre_sam: closing thread here. Postmortem draft assigned to @jing and @raj.

jing: starting draft now, will include MTR and BGP timeline.

raj: will follow-up with provider and attach their incident reference to postmortem.

natalie: done. closing slack thread.
